findings.title: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway Security Bulletin (CTX697305)
findings.summary_md: Cloud Software Group published the NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway security bulletin covering the November 2026 CVE set, including CVE-2026-120869, CVE-2026-118268, and CVE-2026-118269, with fixes in builds 13.1-64.39 and 14.1-73.57 for ADC and Gateway. The bulletin also covers NetScaler ADC FIPS, NetScaler Console, and Secure Access Client for Windows and Linux, with fixed versions 14.1-73.58, 13.1-37.293, 14.1-74.34, 26.11.16, and 26.10.4 respectively. Administrators are urged to upgrade affected appliances and clients to the fixed builds.

findings.title: CVE-2026-120869: Console - An unauthenticated attacker can bypass authentication controls to access restricted resources
findings.summary_md: Threat Radar documents CVE-2026-120869 as an improper authentication vulnerability in Citrix NetScaler Console that allows an unauthenticated attacker to bypass authentication controls and access restricted resources. The flaw affects NetScaler Console prior to 14.1-74.34 and is fixed in 14.1-74.34. No mitigation or temporary workaround is indicated beyond upgrading.

findings.title: Citrix - Meerdere Kwetsbaarheden Verholpen
findings.summary_md: Threat Radar aggregates the November 2026 Citrix update covering 28 CVEs in NetScaler ADC and Gateway, 9 critical and 15 high, plus Secure Access Client and Console fixes. It notes the flaws are less immediately serious than the prior round but still warrant patching. Sources include cve.org and exploit indices as of 12 November 2026.

findings.title: CVE-2026-120869: Console Vulnerability (CVSS 9.3) - Fix and Details
findings.summary_md: Strix documents CVE-2026-120869 as a critical improper authentication flaw in Citrix NetScaler Console rated CVSS 9.3, allowing an unauthenticated attacker to bypass authentication controls and access restricted resources. The issue is fixed in NetScaler Console 14.1-74.34. No workarounds are noted.

findings.title: CVE-2026-120869: Citrix NetScaler Console: An unauthenticated attacker can bypass authentication controls to access restricted resources on the Citrix NetScaler Console appliance
findings.summary_md: Rapid7's vulnerability database lists CVE-2026-120869 affecting Citrix NetScaler Console, where an unauthenticated attacker can bypass authentication controls to access restricted resources on the appliance. The entry references the Citrix support advisory for remediation guidance.
